channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Healthcare providers across the Mud listening area are marking National Rural Health Day. The event celebrates rural healthcare services.
A local family has purchased Middlebury's Marquis Theater. Ben Wells, who owned it for twelve years, sold the property. The theater remains a key cultural spot in the community.

A man accused of assaulting and murdering an eighty-two-year-old woman in Enosburgh has accepted a plea deal. Further details about the case have not been released. Authorities continue to handle the matter.

Otter Valley School Board decided to offer the Whiting school building back to the town. The building is currently leased to ARK Child Care but is no longer used for school purposes. The town must maintain the building for at least five years if it accepts it.
